title: Divergence: thermite-lower::lower_inv_operand misses the cast-LT paren fix (struct type-invariant) — `} inv (x as u32) < cap` mis-parses as a generic (the #146 class, unfixed on the struct-inv path); forge check → L0 `expected ,`

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test pinned at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_struct_inv_cast_lt.rs::struct_invariant_cast_lt_is_parenthesized (#[ignore]'d, blocker #148). Repro: `struct Gauge { x: u64, cap: u64, } inv (x as u32) < cap` → thermite_lower::lower emits the bare `self.x as u32 < self.cap`; forge check → L0 `error: expected ,` (the #146 generic mis-parse). Root cause: lower_inv_operand (the struct type-invariant operand parenthesizer, REQ-8 well_formed path) lacks the cast-< paren guard that lower_binary_operand got in 167b9f4 (is_lt_leading). Same class as #146, separate code path. lower_binary_operand-path clauses (fn req/ens/loop-inv, what forge tv checks) ARE fixed — verified (x as u32) < 33 parenthesizes there.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: plan: pin the struct-invariant cast-< gap as an #[ignore]'d failing test in thermite-lower/tests/divergence_struct_inv_cast_lt.rs (discriminator: write test, do not fix). The fix (give lower_inv_operand the is_lt_leading cast guard) is for the fixer.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: FIXED in fd67cd3 (thermite-lower/src/lower.rs). Two-part single-file fix on the struct type-invariant path: (1) lower_inv_operand now carries the SAME cast-< guard lower_binary_operand got in 167b9f4, REUSING the shared is_lt_leading predicate (Lt/Le/Shl) — no duplication, the convention is uniform across both emission sites; (2) lower_inv_expr gained an explicit Expr::Cast arm so the cast inner recurses through lower_inv_expr (field rewrite x->self.x) while preserving the #122 inner-paren discipline — needed because the catch-all lower_expr emitted the bare 'x as u32' (cannot find value x) even once the outer paren landed. before: 'self.x as u32 < self.cap' (L0 'expected ,'); after: '(self.x as u32) < self.cap'. <=/<< parenthesize; ==/> UNCHANGED (matches #146). forge check (real verus) on the Gauge fixture now reaches L3 (was L0 mis-parse). Gauntlet: cargo test --workspace 684 passed/0 failed; divergence_struct_inv_cast_lt (un-ignored) 1 passed; divergence_cast_paren (#122/#146) 4 passed; clippy PASS; fmt PASS. Hand back for acto-critic re-audit.
